title: RT Calculus Foundation
summary: Establishes RT as the primitive calculus from which linear and nonlinear operational regimes are derived. This patch explicitly prohibits treating either linearity or nonlinearity as an axiomatic floor.

motivation.problem: Previous discussion considered linear and nonlinear mathematics as possible foundational primitives. This risks importing mathematical structure into the framework rather than deriving it from RT.
motivation.resolution: RT remains the sole primitive calculus. Linear and nonlinear behavior become derived operational regimes.

governance_rules.name: RT Primacy
governance_rules.statement: RT_core is the unique primitive calculus of the framework.

governance_rules.name: Derived Mathematical Regimes
governance_rules.statement: Linear and nonlinear operational behavior shall be treated as derived from RT_core rather than as independent primitives.

governance_rules.name: No Imported Mathematical Floor
governance_rules.statement: No external mathematical formalism, including linear algebra or nonlinear algebra, may be treated as the axiomatic foundation of the framework unless independently derived from RT.

deferred_items: Formal derivation of the linear regime.
Formal derivation of the nonlinear regime.
effects: Preserves RT as the unique foundation.
Prevents premature importation of external algebraic assumptions.
Opens a new calculus branch in which mathematical regimes become derivable objects.
theorem_impact: None. Governance and architectural clarification only.

notes: Future linear/nonlinear derivations will attach to this foundation.
This patch is governance and architecture only.
Linear and nonlinear regime language remains downstream of RT_core and does not supersede the canonical root expression.
